Based on the provided context, the answer to your question is:

[2] Sepsis protocol: measure lactate within 1 hour.

This is consistent with the Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines, which recommend measuring lactate levels within 1 hour of presentation in patients with suspected sepsis (1). 

Reference:
(1) Dellinger, R. P., et al. (2013). Surviving sepsis campaign: International guidelines for management of severe sepsis and septic shock: 2012. Critical Care Medicine, 41(2), 580-637.
